## How Has This Been Tested?
Because `create-arc-express` scaffolds many different combinations, all PRs MUST pass the combo test suite.
- [ ] I have run `npm run test:combos` locally and all 13 combinations scaffolded, installed, and booted successfully without syntax errors.
- [ ] I have run `npm run lint` and resolved all ESLint/Prettier warnings.
